## About
Brad Higgins Landscape Services sells and installs sod and puts in and repairs irrigation systems. From the landscaper to the homeowner, we take care of you in the same professional and economical manner.
Our philosophy is simple: provide the best sod and landscape products at the most efficient cost for your residential or commercial needs. We're rated 4.3 on Google from 45 reviews.

## Services
- Sod delivery: Pick up at our yard or have it delivered.
- Wholesale retail: Sod for landscapers buying in volume and for homeowners doing one yard. One reviewer noted we sell by the square.
- Irrigation installation and repair: New sprinkler systems and repairs on the ones you have.
- Freight services: Freight services are also available.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on the weekend?
A: Saturday 8 am to 1 pm. We're closed Sundays.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Call ahead for an appointment.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. We serve both residential and commercial customers.
